title: Everything a user, a file or a tenant can feed the app: PAC evaluator, Test a list, file imports, identity search, URL builders, tenant strings in every renderer

checks.what: 35 adversarial PACs (deep nesting, huge strings, catastrophic shExpMatch, __proto__/constructor, unicode escapes, comment tricks, BOM, CRLF, NUL, lone surrogates, recursion, fork and string bombs) end in a result or 'could not evaluate safely' within the caps
300 deterministic generated PAC programs (seeded) never make evaluate or inspect raise
step, time (injected clock), branch, string, depth and size caps hold under the corpus; parse is linear in calls
Test a list CSV and Excel exports neutralise =cmd| and markup labels (canary run)
0.0.0.0/0, ::/0, /8, IPv6 /64, inverted and mixed ranges, octet > 255, bad prefixes are skipped in words; /16 boundary exact
quote bombs, 3000 columns, NUL and doubled BOM never raise
UTF-16 LE/BE and UTF-8 BOM list files keep header and non-ASCII letters
250,000 rows (3 x /16 plus host names): parse 1.8 s, run 7.8 s, CSV 7 s, Excel (100,000-row cap) 16 s, peak RSS about 580 MB; the line, row and size caps refuse past them

snapshot files: size, nesting, node count, path traversal in answer paths, extra keys, status types (existing tests) plus NaN / Infinity / 1e999 and a type-confusion fuzz of every answer over 12 tenant-reading jobs
ZIA framework files: wrong types, non-string names, hidden characters, megabyte titles, format_version true
POV import: size, depth, format (existing) plus NaN / Infinity
policy pack uploads: NaN / Infinity in any field
HAR batch host entries of the wrong type, NaN and Infinity counts
log uploads: member names reduced to base names, read in memory, archive and member caps (existing tests); request model typed
every POST route's Any/dict/list fields (101 routes, 10 hostile values each, jobs run on the sample tenant) never answer 500; table-driven test over the route table
what-if identity search: 2-64 printable characters; any query (../, ?, #, %2e) reaches only the encoded query string of the fixed endpoint
ZDX custom app URL and AI Guard app list are data for the Zscaler API; the builders import no network library; non-http(s), credentials, bad ports and hosts refused
existing HTML sink scan (101 tests) passes; extended with a URL-sink scan (href/src/action, setAttribute, window.open, location) with a reviewed list of 12 values

canary names (, ${}/%{}, =cmd|, ../, RTL + zero-width) through the sample tenant, 16 jobs and 17 exports in every format: HTML, Markdown, CSV, Excel, Word, PDF, JSON, Terraform (strict HCL), file and member names
checks.standard: ASVS V5.3.1 · CWE-79 · CWE-1236 · CWE-94 · CWE-22

checks.what: real-browser run (Playwright, Chromium) of the canary snapshot through Path analyzer, Test a list, shadowed rules, ZPA, SSL coverage, browser security, device posture, fleet and Bulk changes: no dialog, no injected element; canaries shown as text
HTML pages show a tenant name's bidirectional control as given: table cells and list items confine it; only a sentence the server composes around a name can be reordered on screen

findings.title: A PAC hex literal past 2^1024 raised OverflowError out of pac_eval.evaluate() and inspect() (tenant PAC read, log upload, Test a list); other parse errors were not failed closed
findings.fix: hex literals read as Infinity like JavaScript; compile_pac turns any unexpected parse error into 'could not evaluate safely'

findings.title: PAC parse was quadratic: every call rescanned the source for its line number (1.7 s for 145 KB, outside the 0.5 s evaluation cap)
findings.fix: line numbers by binary search over newline offsets found once

findings.title: An opened snapshot with NaN / Infinity made every job poll on it a 500 (invalid JSON in the result)
An imported POV file with NaN was stored and made the import and every later open of that profile's POV a 500
findings.fix: POV import reads strict JSON; Insights counts kept only when finite

findings.title: A policy pack upload with NaN passed validation (rule rank NaN) and was kept; its bundle download was not JSON

ZIA framework files were not type-checked: fields of the wrong type made the Bulk changes preview a 500, non-string names were coerced, and names with right-to-left overrides or zero-width characters were written to the tenant as rule names
findings.fix: load_framework denies by default: name and title text, fields an object, format_version an integer, no bidirectional / invisible / control character in a name

findings.title: A framework rule title (or a captured rule description) was cut one character at a time with a re-encode each step: quadratic, minutes of CPU for a 1 MB title
findings.fix: _fit_bytes cuts to the byte limit in characters first, then trims

findings.title: HAR batch host entries with a non-list methods/schemes or a NaN / Infinity count answered 500
findings.fix: counts accepted only as finite numbers and lists only as lists

findings.title: The live feed trusted the tally the browser echoes back: unknown keys or wrong types answered 500 (KeyError / TypeError)
findings.fix: live_stats rebuilds the tally from its known counters, whole numbers only

findings.title: Test a list read every file as UTF-8: a UTF-16 list (Excel Unicode Text) lost its header, so its expected column and every non-ASCII letter
findings.fix: the page decodes by byte order mark (UTF-16 LE/BE, else UTF-8)

findings.title: A right-to-left override in a tenant name reordered the text after it in Markdown, CSV, Excel and Word exports, and sat raw in generated Terraform source (Trojan Source style)
findings.fix: export cleaners show explicit bidirectional controls as U+FFFD; Terraform strings escape invisible characters as \uNNNN (read back unchanged by the pack reader)
